hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: Array length n is at most 50.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Iterate through every possible subarray [i, j]. Check if removing elements from index i to j leaves a strictly increasing array.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: The remaining elements consist of prefix nums[0..i-1] and suffix nums[j+1..n-1]. Check that prefix is strictly increasing, suffix is strictly increasing, and prefix[-1] < suffix[0].

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: size of input array or string
complexity.notes: Efficient execution matching optimal computational complexity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute force exceeds standard time constraints.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify core invariants and leverage optimal structures.
